arxiv-2103-05177.title: q q -Moment Estimates for the Singular p p -Laplace Equation and Applications Thanks: National Science Foundation of China, Grants Numbers: 11971310 and 11671257 are gratefully acknowledged.
arxiv-2103-05177.creator: Samuel Drapeau, Liming Yin
arxiv-2103-05177.description: Abstract . We provide q q -moment estimates on annuli for weak solutions of the singular p p -Laplace equation where p p and q q are conjugates. We derive q q -uniform integrability for some critical parameter range. As a application, we derive a mass conservation as well as a weak convergence result for a larger critical parameter range.

arxiv-2104-14525.title: Testing and estimation for clustered signals
arxiv-2104-14525.creator: Hongyuan Cao, Wei Biao Wu
arxiv-2104-14525.description: Abstract We propose a change-point detection method for large scale multiple testing problems with data having clustered signals. Unlike the classic change-point setup, the signals can vary in size within a cluster. The clustering structure on the signals enables us to effectively delineate the boundaries between signal and non-signal segments.

arxiv-2309-05120.title: Routing and charging game in ride-hailing service with electric vehicles
arxiv-2309-05120.creator: Kenan Zhang, John Lygeros
arxiv-2309-05120.description: Abstract This paper studies the routing and charging behaviors of electric vehicles in a competitive ride-hailing market. When the vehicles are idle, they can choose whether to continue cruising to search for passengers, or move a charging station to recharge. The behaviors of individual vehicles are then modeled by a Markov decision process (MDP).

arxiv-2310-12405.title: LoMAE: Low-level Vision Masked Autoencoders for Low-dose CT Denoising Thanks: The paper was submitted on Oct. 1, 2023. This work was supported in part by NIH/NIBIB under grants R01EB032807 and R01EB3473, and NIH/NCI under grant R21CA264772. Thanks: D. Wang, Y. Xu, S. Han, L. Zhou, B. Morovati, and H
arxiv-2310-12405.creator: Dayang Wang, Yongshun Xu, Shuo Han, Zhan Wu
arxiv-2310-12405.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dayang Wang, Yongshun Xu, Shuo Han, Zhan Wu. Low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) offers reduced X-ray radiation exposure but at the cost of compromised image quality, characterized by increased noise and artifacts. Recently, transformer models emerged as a promising avenue to enhance LDCT image quality. However, the success of such models relies on a large amount of paired noisy and clean images, which are often scarce in clinical settings.

arxiv-2310-15523.title: Generative and Contrastive Paradigms Are Complementary for Graph Self-Supervised Learning
arxiv-2310-15523.creator: Yuxiang Wang † Xiao Yan # Chuang Hu † Fangcheng Fu ‡ Wentao Zhang ‡ Hao Wang † Shuo Shang § Jiawei Jiang †
arxiv-2310-15523.description: Abstract . For graph self-supervised learning (GSSL), masked autoencoder (MAE) follows the generative paradigm and learns to reconstruct masked graph edges or node features. Contrastive Learning (CL) maximizes the similarity between augmented views of the same graph and is widely used for GSSL. However, MAE and CL are considered separately in existing works for GSSL.

arxiv-2402-13581.title: Maker-Breaker domination game played on corona products of graphs
arxiv-2402-13581.creator: Athira Divakaran, Tijo James, Sandi Klavžar, Latha S Nair
arxiv-2402-13581.description: Abstract In the Maker-Breaker domination game, Dominator and Staller play on a graph G G by taking turns in which each player selects a not yet played vertex of G G . Dominator’s goal is to select all the vertices in a dominating set, while Staller aims to prevent this from happening.

arxiv-2402-15077.title: The Pixel Charging-up effect in Gas Micro-Pixel Detectors Journal: NIM-A
arxiv-2402-15077.creator: Di-Fan Yi, Qian Liu, Hong-Bang Liu, Fei Xie, Huan-Bo Feng, Lin Zhou, Zu-ke Feng, Yang-Heng Zheng
arxiv-2402-15077.description: Abstract This study investigates the charging-up effect on the Topmetal-II - chip in Gas Micro-Pixel Detectors(GMPD). It is found that this effect differs from the charging-up typically observed in gas detector multiplier devices and increases the relative gain of the detector.

arxiv-2506-22661.title: Enhancing Neural Audio Fingerprint Robustness to Audio Degradation for Music Identification
arxiv-2506-22661.description: Abstract Audio fingerprinting (AFP) allows the identification of unknown audio content by extracting compact representations, termed audio fingerprints, that are designed to remain robust against common audio degradations. Neural AFP methods often employ metric learning, where representation quality is influenced by the nature of the supervision and the utilized loss function.

arxiv-2507-12421.title: A graphene platform for nano scale coherent interaction of surface plasmons with resonant atomic ensembles
arxiv-2507-12421.creator: Ali.A. Kamli 1, S.A.Moiseev 2
arxiv-2507-12421.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ali.A. Kamli 1, S.A.Moiseev 2. We propose a 2D graphene structure containing atomic ensemble as a platform for implementing nanoscale enhanced coherent interactions of plasmonic fields with resonant atomic systems. We determine the graphene surface plasmon modes, and the properties of its electromagnetic fields, and emphasize the role of graphene sheet separation on the interaction with atomic systems for various dipole orientations and positions between the graphene sheets. We analyze the conditions for implementation of coherent interaction of SP mode with resonant atomic ensembles.

arxiv-2509-10681.title: Statistical Analysis of Magnetic Patches in Solar Active Regions Using the Complex Network Method
arxiv-2509-10681.creator: Zahra Tajik, Hasan Rezaei, Mehdi Simiari, Hossien Safari
arxiv-2509-10681.description: Abstract Identifying solar active regions (ARs), which consist of one or more pairs of magnetic patches with opposite polarities, is essential due to their significant role in dynamic solar atmospheric phenomena. In this study, we analyze ARs during their emergence and evolution on the solar surface using a complex network-based method known as Identifying Solar Magnetic Patches (ISMP).

arxiv-2509-24178.title: BladderFormer: A Streaming Transformer for Real-Time Urological State Monitoring
arxiv-2509-24178.creator: Chengwei Zhou, Steve Majerus, Gourav Datta
arxiv-2509-24178.description: Abstract Bladder pressure monitoring systems are increasingly vital in diagnosing and managing urinary tract dysfunction. Existing solutions rely heavily on hand-crafted features and shallow classifiers, limiting their adaptability to complex signal dynamics. We propose a one-layer streaming transformer model for real-time classification of bladder pressure states, operating on wavelet-transformed representations of raw time-series data.

arxiv-2602-10735.title: Calliope: A TTS-based Narrated E-book Creator Ensuring Exact Synchronization, Privacy, and Layout Fidelity
arxiv-2602-10735.creator: Hugo L. Hammer, Vajira Thambawita, Pål Halvorsen
arxiv-2602-10735.description: Abstract A narrated e-book combines synchronized audio with digital text, highlighting the currently spoken word or sentence during playback. This format supports early literacy and assists individuals with reading challenges, while also allowing general readers to seamlessly switch between reading and listening.

britannica-1911-leven-and-melville-earls.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-leven-and-melville-earls.description: Article 'Leven and Melville, Earls of' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. which now holds these two earldoms is descended from Sir John Melville of Raith in Fifeshire. Sir John, who was a member of the reforming party in Scotland, was put to death for high treason on the 13th of December 1548; he left with other children a son Robert (1527–1621), who in 1616 was created a lord of parliament as Lord Melville of Monymaill.

However, the local accuracy of an assembly remains difficult to assess and improve. The gEVAL browser allows the user to interrogate an assembly i

pmc-10595740.title: Age-friendly practices during the COVID-19 pandemic: Findings from a scoping review
pmc-10595740.creator: V Guzman, E Kinsella, M Pertl, R Foley, F Doyle
pmc-10595740.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic called for innovation and leverage of existing age-friendly practices to promote older people's functional ability and enable them to contribute to their communities and enjoy life. Our aim was to explore the evidence available concerning the development, adaptation, and evaluation of age-friendly practices during the COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-11502617.title: A rate-responsive duty-cycling protocol for leadless pacemaker synchronization
pmc-11502617.creator: Adrian Ryser, Tobias Reichlin, Jürgen Burger, Thomas Niederhauser, Andreas Haeberlin
pmc-11502617.description: Dual-chamber leadless pacemakers (LLPMs) consist of two implants, one in the right atrium and one in the right ventricle. Inter-device communication, required for atrioventricular (AV) synchrony, however, reduces the projected longevity of commercial dual-chamber LLPMs by 35–45%. This work analyzes the power-saving potential and the resulting impact on AV-synchrony for a novel LLPM synchronization protocol.

pmc-11634028.title: MRCK-1 activates non-muscle myosin for outgrowth of a unicellular tube in Caenorhabditis elegans
pmc-11634028.creator: Evelyn M Popiel, Rhea Ahluwalia, Stefan Schuetz, Bin Yu, W Brent Derry
pmc-11634028.description: The formation and patterning of unicellular biological tubes is essential for metazoan development. It is well established that vascular tubes and neurons use similar guidance cues to direct their development, but the downstream mechanisms that promote the outgrowth of biological tubes are not well characterized.

pmc-12523534.title: Evaluation of Nasal Microbial Communities of Beef Calves During Pre-Weaning Outbreak of Bovine Respiratory Disease
pmc-12523534.creator: Amy N. Abrams, Larry A. Kuehn, John W. Keele, Michael G. Gonda, Tara G. McDaneld
pmc-12523534.description: Simple SummaryBovine respiratory disease is one of the most costly and common health problems affecting young beef calves, causing sickness, death, and significant economic losses for cattle producers. While many bacteria live naturally in the nasal cavity of healthy calves, some can become harmful under stressful conditions and trigger disease outbreaks.

pmc-12753764.title: Multi-sensor observer-based residual learning with Auto-Permutation Feature Importance for fault diagnosis of multistage centrifugal pumps under variable pressures
pmc-12753764.creator: Saif Ullah, Muhammad Farooq Siddique, Jong-Myon Kim
pmc-12753764.description: Recent progress in deep learning has improved fault diagnosis, but such models typically demand large, labeled data and struggle with overfitting when data is limited or imbalanced. Collecting data under faulty machine conditions is challenging, as artificially inducing faults can damage other parts. Additionally, feature extraction pipelines often produce high-dimensional, redundant representations that hinder interpretability and efficiency.

pmc-12959250.title: The sex‐specific association between long‐term PM2.5 exposure and incident dementia in community‐dwelling older adults in Australia
pmc-12959250.creator: Aoshuang Zhou, Zhen Zhou, Wenhua Yu, Tingting Ye, Alice Owen, Robyn Woods, Suzanne Orchard, Rory Wolfe, Yuming Guo, Joanne Ryan
pmc-12959250.description: INTRODUCTIONAir pollution is linked to dementia, but evidence from low‐exposure settings is limited. We examined sex‐specific associations between long‐term exposure to fine particulate matter ≤2.5 µm in diameter (PM2.5) and dementia risk in older adults living in Australia.METHODSIn 16,145 dementia‐free Aspirin in Reducing Events in the Elderly (ASPREE) participants (≥70 years; median follow‐up 10.

pmc-13359864.title: Diagnostic Performance of Vertical and Sagittal Cephalometric Parameters in Differentiating Skeletal Malocclusion in Saudi Adults: A Cephalometric Study
pmc-13359864.creator: Mohammad A. Hamidaddin, Guna Shekhar Madiraju, Faris Yahya I. Asiri, Salem Abdulrahman Albalawi, Abdulelah Abdulrahman Alfalah, Hatim D. Alqurashi
pmc-13359864.description: Background/Objective: This study evaluated the diagnostic performance of vertical growth patterns and mandibular morphology, alongside the anteroposterior dysplasia indicator (APDI), for classifying skeletal malocclusions in a Saudi adult population using cephalometric analysis. Materials and Methods: This retrospective cross-sectional discriminatory performance study analyzed 162 archived lateral cephalometric radiographs of Saudi adults aged 18–44 years.

pmc-13435261.title: Design Patterns for the Development and Implementation of Bioacoustic Deep Learning Recognizers
pmc-13435261.creator: Gavin Hurd, Robin Baron, Jesse Whittington
pmc-13435261.description: Bioacoustic monitoring using autonomous recording units generates volumes of audio data that exceed the capacity of manual annotation, necessitating the use of automated species recognizers. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have emerged as the dominant approach due to their strong performance on spectrogram representations of audio data, yet their development and deployment remain challenging.

pmc-13688942.title: Nomogram construction and validation for hypoalbuminemia after total hip arthroplasty in patients with hip fractures
pmc-13688942.creator: Xiaodong Jia, Yu Jiang, Wanxue Wang, Xia Zhao, Tengbo Yu, Yingze Zhang, Tianrui Wang, Kuishuai Xu
pmc-13688942.description: BackgroundTo investigate the risk factors for hypoalbuminemia after total hip arthroplasty (THA) in patients with hip fractures and to establish and validate a risk prediction nomogram.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on the clinical data of 688 patients with hip fractures who underwent THA at The Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University between January 2021 and June 2025.
